components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button with crimson fill and high contrast typography
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #CC3D4A; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: Cairo, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px 24px; min-height: 52px; width: 100%; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(204, 61, 74, 0.22); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #9E2938; }

components.name: Medical Card
components.description: Clean white card with subtle border and soft ambient shadow
components.css: .ds-card-clinical { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #DCE4EA; border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); font-family: Cairo, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: LifeLink is designed for Egyptian emergency rooms, blood bank logistics, and generous voluntary donors. Its visual atmosphere balances clinical authority with human reassurance. In a crisis, caregivers are stressed and cognitively overloaded; donors want seamless gratitude and clear impact.
keyCharacteristics: Calm Authority: Clean white cards with whisper borders (#DCE4EA) and soft ambient shadows.
RTL-Native Ergonomics: Built specifically for Arabic Cairo typography, right-to-left layout flows, and 48dp minimum touch targets.
Strict Clinical Contrast: WCAG AA compliant text pairings ensuring high visibility under emergency room harsh lighting.

rules.name: The Rarity of Red Rule
rules.body: Crimson red is never used for input focus outlines or decorative borders; input focus must use Clinical Blue to avoid falsely mimicking an error state.

rules.name: The Native RTL Rule
rules.body: All screen typography and icon orientations must respect Arabic text direction. Directional icons must point along the reading line.

dos: Do provide native RTL navigation arrows (Icons.arrow_back_rounded) that flip automatically.
Do maintain a minimum 48x48 dp touch target for all buttons and interactive chips.
Do use Clinical Blue for input focus indicators to avoid confusion with validation errors.
donts: Don't hardcode Icons.arrow_back_ios_rounded which points the wrong way in Arabic RTL.
Don't use Crimson red for input focus borders or neutral outlines.
Don't allow caregivers to manually initiate blood bag requests or transport fragile blood products.
